dict.string: Reverie uses the microphone to record voice memos that capture your thoughts and feelings. Your recordings are stored privately on your device.
Reverie accesses your photo library to let you attach meaningful images to your journal entries. Photos are stored privately within the app.
Reverie uses the camera to capture moments you want to include in your journal entries. Photos are stored privately within the app.
Reverie uses speech recognition to transcribe your spoken words into journal entries, making it easier to capture your thoughts.
Reverie sends you gentle daily reminders to check in with your emotional well-being. These notifications help you build a consistent journaling practice.
